messages.reviewUnavailable: Packing is not available in review mode
messages.accountRequired: Packing needs a signed-in staff account (the operator is recorded). This device session cannot use it.
messages.noOwner: This account has no store or warehouse to pack for. Ask an administrator for access.

owner.title: Switch store
owner.subtitle: Choose the store or warehouse you are packing and receiving for. It is remembered on this device.

home.title: Packing
home.scanPlaceholder: Scan a carton or pallet label to open it
home.cameraTitle: Scan a carton or pallet label
home.unknownCode: {{code}} is not a carton or pallet number
home.emptyIncomingHint: Goods another store or the warehouse sent to you and you have not received yet show up here
home.emptyHint: Tap New carton or Pallet above to start
home.palletHeaderNotSaved: Pallet created, but the consignment number / note was not saved. Add it with Change on the pallet page.

destination.subtitle: You can leave it empty and set it before dispatch.
destination.noneHint: No destination yet: leave it for now and set it before dispatching or storing.
destination.localHint: Keep in store: after sealing it stays in this store. You can record a storage location. It is not dispatched.
destination.localWarehouseHint: In warehouse: after sealing it stays in the warehouse. You can record a bin location. It is not dispatched.
destination.warehouseHint: Return to the warehouse: the warehouse scans to receive it after you dispatch.
destination.noStores: No other stores to choose from
destination.noCarriers: No carriers yet. Add one below.
destination.receiveNote: After dispatch the other side must scan to receive. Once received, the carton belongs to them. Transfers only record the carton's destination and do not change either store's stock.
destination.remark: Note (optional, e.g. fragile / this side up)

location.scanPlaceholder: Scan a location label / enter a location name
location.noMatch: No matching location. Pressing return will try what you typed.
location.emptyWarehouse: The warehouse has no locations yet. Create them in Products & locations first.
location.empty: This store has no storage locations yet
location.newName: Location name, e.g. Back room shelf A
location.addHint: After adding, tap the print icon on its row to print a location label for the shelf.

pack.title: Pack carton
pack.scanPlaceholder: Scan product barcode / enter item number
pack.outsideOrderNotice: This product is not on the linked store order. It was packed anyway.
pack.emptyHint: Scan product barcodes with the scanner or camera. Every scan is saved straight away.
pack.removeBody: {{name}} will go to 0 and be removed from the carton.
pack.voidBody: {{cartonNo}} cannot be restored once voided. Its product records are discarded.
pack.ambiguousTip: {{code}} matches several products. Choose the one to pack.

quantity.editHint: Enter the total pieces of this product in this carton. Enter 0 to remove it.
quantity.label: Pieces

seal.weightInvalid: Weight is not valid. Enter kilograms, e.g. 12.5

carton.title: Seal carton & print label
carton.subtitle: Once sealed, products cannot be added or removed. To change it, reopen the carton (this is logged).

pallet.title: Seal pallet & print label
pallet.subtitle: Once sealed, cartons cannot be added or removed. To change it, reopen the pallet.

print.sealedButFailed: Sealed, but the label did not print. Connect the printer and reprint: {{detail}}

sealed.title: Carton sealed
sealed.dispatchHint: Send to {{target}}; they scan to receive
sealed.dispatchBody: {{cartonNo}} goes to {{target}}. After dispatch you can no longer change it; the other side scans to receive it.
sealed.dispatched: Dispatched. Waiting for {{target}} to scan and receive.
sealed.chooseDestinationHint: Send to another store / the warehouse, or keep in store
sealed.putOnPalletHint: Scan a pallet label, or create a pallet
sealed.palletSheetHint: Scan a pallet label or enter the pallet number, or pick a pallet being built below.
sealed.newPalletAndAdd: Create a pallet and put it on
sealed.notPallet: This is not a pallet number
sealed.mismatchBody: This carton's destination differs from pallet {{palletNo}}. Adding it anyway needs a store manager.
sealed.openPalletHint: This carton is on pallet {{palletNo}}. Dispatch the whole pallet.
sealed.putToLocationHint: Scan a location label to record where the carton is
sealed.locationSheetHint: Choose a storage location, or scan a location label / enter its name.
sealed.scanHint: Only pallet and carton labels are read here. To set a storage location, tap Storage location first.
sealed.reopenBody: After reopening you can add or remove products. The carton number stays and the old label remains valid. Needs a store manager and is logged.
sealed.reopenManagerOnly: Only a store manager can reopen a carton
sealed.reopenOnPalletHint: A carton on a pallet cannot be reopened. Remove it from the pallet first.
sealed.reopenManagerNote: Reopening a carton needs a store manager

readonly.outgoing: Dispatched. Waiting for {{target}} to scan and receive. It can no longer be changed here.
readonly.incoming: This was sent to you by {{origin}} and has not been received yet.
readonly.other: This carton / pallet is not in your store. View only.
readonly.palletPartlyReceived: Dispatched. {{target}} has received {{received}} of {{total}} cartons; the rest are still in transit.

pallet.title: Build pallet
pallet.scanPlaceholder: Scan a carton label to add it
pallet.emptyTitle: No cartons on this pallet yet
pallet.emptyHint: Scan sealed carton labels to add them. Carton contents follow onto the pallet.
pallet.alreadyOn: This carton is already on this pallet
pallet.removeBody: {{cartonNo}} will come off the pallet and become a loose carton.
pallet.blockedNotSealed: {{cartonNo}} is not sealed yet. Seal the carton before putting it on a pallet.
pallet.blockedOtherPallet: {{cartonNo}} is already on pallet {{palletNo}}. Remove it from that pallet first.
pallet.blockedMismatch: {{cartonNo}} is going to {{cartonDestination}}, which differs from this pallet's destination {{palletDestination}}.
pallet.blockedManagerOnly: {{cartonNo}} has a different destination. Only a store manager can allow it; this account cannot add it.
pallet.managerOnly: Only a store manager can allow a destination mismatch

palletSealed.title: Pallet sealed
palletSealed.reopenBody: After reopening you can add or remove cartons. The pallet number stays. Needs a store manager.
palletSealed.reopenManagerOnly: Only a store manager can reopen a pallet
palletSealed.dispatchHint: Send to {{target}} as one pallet; they scan to receive
palletSealed.dispatchBody: {{palletNo}} ({{cartons}} cartons) goes to {{target}}. After dispatch you can no longer change it; the other side scans to receive it.
palletSealed.dispatched: The whole pallet was dispatched. Waiting for the other side to scan and receive.

receive.title: Receive goods
receive.scanPlaceholder: Scan a pallet or carton label
receive.cameraTitle: Scan a pallet or carton label
receive.notFound: No carton or pallet found for {{code}}
receive.countMismatch: You counted {{entered}} cartons but the system has {{actual}}, so the pallet cannot be received as a whole. Scan each carton label to check and receive only the ones that arrived.
receive.doneChecked: {{cartons}} checked cartons; the rest stay in To receive
receive.doneOne: This carton now belongs to this store
receive.checkedConfirmBody: {{total}} cartons on the pallet are still in transit. Only the {{checked}} checked ones will be received; the rest stay in To receive so the sender can see which are missing.

blocked.notForYou: This was sent to {{target}}, not to {{owner}} where you are now, so it cannot be received here. Switch to the receiving store if needed.
blocked.notInTransit: This is not in transit right now: it may not be dispatched yet, or it has already been received.
blocked.empty: There are no cartons left to receive on this pallet.

receive.emptyHint: You can also scan a pallet or carton label to receive it directly
receive.locationSubtitle: Choose a storage location or scan a location label. Leave it empty to receive without a location.
receive.viaTitle: This carton is on a pallet
receive.viaNote: If the pallet label is lost or unreadable, the label of any carton on the pallet can receive the whole pallet.
receive.actualCountHint: Count the cartons on the pallet
receive.mismatchCaption: If your count differs from the {{count}} cartons on record, check carton by carton instead

locate.title: Product location
locate.placeholder: Scan product barcode / enter item number
locate.idleTitle: Find where a packed product is
locate.idleHint: Scan a product barcode or enter an item number to list quantity and destination: kept here, in transit, received by them
locate.emptyTitle: No packing records for this product
locate.emptyHint: Only cartons kept here, dispatched from here or sent here are shown
locate.emptyHintWarehouse: Warehouse stock is shown for reference only. Packing does not change stock.

errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The request is incomplete. Check and try again.
errors.PACKING_NOT_ALLOWED: This account is not allowed to do this packing action
errors.OWNER_REQUIRED: Choose a store or the warehouse first
errors.OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot work in this store
errors.CODE_NOT_FOUND: No product found for this code
errors.CODE_AMBIGUOUS: This code matches several products. Choose one.
errors.CARTON_NOT_PACKING: This carton is sealed. Reopen it first.
errors.CARTON_NOT_SEALED: This carton is not sealed yet
errors.CARTON_EMPTY: An empty carton cannot be sealed
errors.CARTON_ON_PALLET: This carton is on a pallet, so its destination and location follow the pallet. Remove it from the pallet first.
errors.CARTON_ON_OTHER_PALLET: This carton is already on another pallet
errors.CARTON_IN_TRANSIT: This carton has been dispatched and can no longer be changed
errors.DESTINATION_MISMATCH: This carton's destination differs from the pallet
errors.DESTINATION_INVALID: Destination is incomplete: another store needs a receiving store, a carrier needs one chosen
errors.PALLET_NOT_BUILDING: This pallet is sealed. Reopen it first.
errors.PALLET_NOT_SEALED: Only a sealed pallet can be reopened
errors.PALLET_EMPTY: An empty pallet cannot be sealed or dispatched
errors.PALLET_NOT_EMPTY: The pallet still has cartons. Remove them first.
errors.PALLET_IN_TRANSIT: This pallet has been dispatched and can no longer be changed
errors.LOCATION_NAME_TAKEN: This store already has a location with this name
errors.CARRIER_NAME_TAKEN: A carrier with this name already exists
errors.NOT_SHIPPABLE: To dispatch, seal it first and choose a destination (another store or the warehouse)
errors.NOT_IN_TRANSIT: This is not in transit, so it cannot be received
errors.NOT_FOR_YOU: This was not sent to where you are now
errors.COUNT_MISMATCH: The count differs from the system record. Check carton by carton.
